name: io.github.sadofriod/graphrag-ts
title: graphrag-ts citation provenance
description: Source-tiered retraction and citation judgments for DOIs; abstains when evidence is thin.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Without a key you get the public read tier: integrity_paper_status answers for free, while retraction_propagation ($0.02) and integrity_evidence_audit ($0.10) return payment_required and are paid per call with x402 at POST /api/v1/judge. 20 requests/minute per IP. A key unlocks the full tool set.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: none for the public read tier; bearer for the full tool set
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.retrieval: citation graph + retraction status over OpenAlex/Crossref/Retraction Watch
